transcripts.rawText: Had stomach upset today. Not sure what exactly. Just feeling off, nothing specific I can point to. Maybe will pass on its own.

context.doctorInstructions: Log any symptoms that last more than a day.

transcripts.rawText: Morning had fever, took paracetamol. Evening feeling better, no fever now. But also still having the fever I think? Temperature is confusing me. One moment hot, one moment normal.
I think I have food poisoning from yesterday's dinner at the dhaba. All symptoms match — vomits, loose motions, feeling very weak. Pretty sure it is food poisoning only.

context.doctorInstructions: Log all vomiting and loose motion episodes.

transcripts.rawText: The metformin dose feels too high. Should I stop taking it? Or reduce to half tablet? Feeling dizzy and nauseous after each dose for past three days.

context.doctorInstructions: Do not change medication without consulting doctor.

transcripts.rawText: Felt a bit off after lunch today. Not sure if it is the food or just work stress. Maybe overthinking it. Will see how it goes, probably nothing.
Very hard to breathe since morning. Chest feels very tight and painful. Started suddenly around eight AM. Feeling very scared, cannot take deep breath.

context.doctorInstructions: Use inhaler as prescribed and report any breathing difficulty immediately.

transcripts.rawText: Yesterday after dinner I threw up twice and felt dizzy. I skipped my antibiotic because I thought it caused the vomiting. Today I ate curd rice and felt stomach pain again, but no fever.

context.doctorInstructions: Track vomiting, meals, pain, and medication adherence.

transcripts.rawText: Stomach pain after eating dal-chawal today morning. Doctor mentioned I can take antacid if it gets bad. Should I start the antacid now or wait to see if pain gets worse?

context.doctorInstructions: Antacid available if needed. Log meal-related pain.

transcripts.rawText: Pain after meals is getting worse these past two days. The tablet is not helping much. Can I take two tablets instead of one today to get some relief?

context.doctorInstructions: One tablet before meals. Do not increase dose without checking.

transcripts.rawText: I am on prednisone for two weeks now. Feeling much better, pain almost gone. Can I start reducing the dose slowly on my own? Do not want to bother the clinic just for this.

context.doctorInstructions: Taper only as directed. Do not self-taper steroids.
